mapper.sql: select u.user_id person_id, u.user_name person_code, u.nick_name person_name, u.dept_id, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.status as user_status, d.dept_name, u.post_id position_name, u.email, u.phonenumber mobile, u.status, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id
mapper.select:
and u.user_name like concat('%', #{personCode}, '%') and u.nick_name like concat('%', #{personName}, '%') and (u.dept_id = #{deptId} or u.dept_id in ( select dept_id from sys_dept where find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors))) and u.status = #{status} and u.del_flag = '0'
order by u.user_id desc

where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or d.dept_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by u.nick_name, u.user_id limit 100

select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.status from sys_user u where u.del_flag = '0' and (u.status = '0' or u.user_id = (select user_id from pm_person where person_id = #{personId})) and not exists ( select 1 from pm_person p where p.user_id = u.user_id and (#{personId} is null or p.person_id <> #{personId}) )
and (u.user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by u.user_name, u.user_id limit 100
mapper.insert: insert into pm_person(person_code, person_name, dept_id, user_id, position_name, email, mobile, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{personCode}, #{personName}, #{deptId}, #{userId}, #{positionName}, #{email}, #{mobile}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from pm_person where person_id in #{personId}
